_comment: One LPDDR6 channel (2 subchannels x 2 ranks); run packages with --lp6-config configs/LPDDR6_PIM_Mobile_2CH.ini. Cost model and mapping policy of npu-hybrid (include/npu/Transforms/Hybrid.h). NPU values follow the simulator settings (800 MHz, 4 cores, 32x32 array); PIM values follow lp6-pim-main configs/LPDDR6_PIM_Mobile_2CH.ini (2400 MHz, 8 PUs x 4 lanes, 2 subchannels x 2 ranks, nLLD 10 CK). Fitted 2026-09-29 to this compiler's runs of Qwen3-4B layer 0 (M=1) on IESLAB_NPU_Simulator + lp6-pim-main (rarobacobgch): pim.efficiency 0.624 and phase_fixed_us 0 from the PIM phases (one sweep = 3.38-3.42 us for every group incl. lm_head, intercept ~0); act_write_* (scatter, 16 B written per activation byte) and readback_* (gather) from NPU phase timelines. npu.lp6_read_gbps 17.9 from the 36-layer NPU-only W8A8 step (242.3 ms, of which about 17.9 ms is non-GEMV NPU work as measured in the hybrid's NPU phases, for 4.02 GB of INT8 weights); gemv_fixed_us 2.0 is a starting value, not fitted. None of these values is from the LPDDR6-PIM PDF. pim.concurrent_ranks is false because the draft defines no rank-to-rank rule for PIM compute: a PIM phase runs on the two subchannels of one rank. mapping.policy: cost (compare estimates), npu or pim (every group); mapping.overrides: weight-name substring -> npu | pim, longest match first.
